item.text: [{"task_id":"e41c6fd3","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    background = int(round(params['rule'][0]))","    anchor = int(round(params['rule'][1]))","    axis = int(round(params['rule'][2]))","    if axis < 0 or axis >= len(grid.shape) or anchor == background:","        return grid.copy()","    anchor_points = np.argwhere(grid == anchor)","    if len(anchor_points) == 0:","        return grid.copy()","    target = int(np.min(anchor_points[:, axis]))","    result = np.full(grid.shape, background, dtype=int)","    for color in np.unique(grid):","        if color == background:","            continue","        points = np.argwhere(grid == color)","        start = int(np.min(points[:, axis]))","        for point in points:","            destination = point.tolist()","            destination[axis] += target - start","            if all(value >= 0 and value < size for value, size in zip(destination, grid.shape)):","                result[tuple(destination)] = int(color)","    return result"],"shapes":{"rule":[3]},"params":{"rule":[0,8,0]},"rationale":"Translate each colored object vertically so its top aligns with the top of the cyan object (8), preserving its shape and horizontal position. The tensor specifies background, anchor color, and alignment axis."}]
